full_judgment: 12. In the facts and circumstances of the case we hold that the learned Judge of the High Court Division upon proper appreciation of the material facts and on consideration of the findings arrived at by the trial Court, on the evidence on records, rightly reversed the judgment and decree of the lower appellate Court, as not being a proper judgment of reversal both on facts as well as on law. The impugned judgment of the High Court Division, therefore, does not warrant any interference. The petition is dismissed.
